note: Wroclaw shipped wro_001 to wro_004 on 2026-08-15: the four named oaks of Wielka Wyspa (Jan Dzierzon, Dziadek, Piotr Wlast, Jan Stanko). None of the leads below were delivered. They are what the 2026-08-15 verification pass (Poland GDOS register, trees within 5km of the centre) left behind, kept as stock for when Wroclaw grows past 4. Never rendered.

leads.name: The Witness Plane (SWIADEK)
leads.why: Named single-tree GDOS register entry, designated 2020-02-19, 1.17km from the city centre, west of the verified Wielka Wyspa oak cluster and not walkable with it. Not verified this pass for time; needs a second source, street address and access check before it can ship. Source: http://crfop.gdos.gov.pl/CRFOP/widok/viewpomnikprzyrody.jsf?fop=PL.ZIPOP.1393.PP.0264011.2220208

leads.name: Dab Nestor
leads.why: Named oak, GDOS register designation 2009-02-17, 3.36km from the city centre and 1.3-1.9km from the verified Wielka Wyspa cluster, on the edge of walkable. Not verified this pass; needs a second source (a survey or press piece with measurements) and an access check. Source: http://crfop.gdos.gov.pl/CRFOP/widok/viewpomnikprzyrody.jsf?fop=PL.ZIPOP.1393.PP.0264011.2380

leads.name: Grupa debow (group of oaks) near Jana Stanki
leads.why: A 'group of oaks' register entry (wieloobiektowy/grupa drzew, three point records at essentially one site), designated 1953-02-16, 2.9km from the centre and only about 400-500m from wro_004 (the Jana Stanki oak) inside Park Szczytnicki, genuinely walkable with the verified cluster. Not individually checked this pass: needs establishing whether it reads as one collectible ensemble or several separate worthwhile oaks, plus a second source for whichever it is. The strongest candidate to extend this city past 4. Source (one of three near-identical point records): http://crfop.gdos.gov.pl/CRFOP/widok/viewpomnikprzyrody.jsf?fop=PL.ZIPOP.1393.PP.0264011.2282

leads.name: Wroclaw Zoo dendrological embankment cluster
leads.species: Ginkgo biloba, Chamaecyparis lawsoniana, Thuja occidentalis, Taxus baccata, Chamaecyparis pisifera, Cercidiphyllum japonicum, Populus nigra, Celtis occidentalis, Ulmus laevis, Sorbus torminalis, Castanea sativa (11 separate single-tree register entries)
leads.why: A dense run of individually-designated exotic and native trees (designated 1999-2011, various dates) clustered tightly around the Wroclaw Zoo / Park Szczytnicki area, roughly 2.0-3.0km from the centre. A general web search places this concentration 'on an embankment at the section of the Zoological Garden', meaning likely paid zoo entry rather than free park; not verified tree by tree this pass. A future pass must confirm, per tree, whether it stands on the free park side or inside the paid zoo and say so honestly in access; paid entry is publishable as long as access states it plainly. See poland-gdos-pomniki-przyrody.json filtered to lat 51.108-51.118 / lon 17.067-17.076, near_city Wroclaw, for the full list of gids.
